fixes: Turn on the RevenueCat → Mixpanel integration. Trials, conversions, renewals and refunds land on the same person, which unlocks trial → paid and real MRR.
Tag App Store links on the site with campaign tokens (?pt=…&ct=home_hero, ct=start_done and so on). App Store Connect then shows installs per placement, which closes the site → install gap.

Give every social link its own tag. Point the Instagram and YouTube bio links to wisdomquotes.in/?utm_source=instagram (or youtube), and send any direct App Store link with ct=ig_bio / ct=yt_bio. Zernio reports 0 profile views and 0 website clicks for every reel, so check the Instagram account's insights permission in Zernio as well.
Filter sandbox purchases. Add environment (sandbox/production) to Purchase Completed and exclude $ae_iap from reports. Today's 47 v3 events are all tests.
Add country as a super property in the app so every funnel can be split into ICP vs India from day one of v3.
Name the web /start events to match the app (Verse Revealed, Week Started) so the web 7-day plan and the app plan show up in one Mixpanel funnel.

web.weeklyClicksNote: The week of 2 Nov finished at 564 clicks on 30.3k impressions, the best week yet. The week of 9 Nov has 384 clicks after five days (13 Nov is still partial), on pace to land close to it. CTR fell from about 2.4% to 1.9% as impressions grew faster than clicks.
web.weeklyVisitorsNote: The 28 Sep spike (863) was a one-off. Underneath it, visitors were flat at about 300 a week until the week of 26 Oct, which reached 619. The week of 2 Nov finished at 848, the best week so far, and the week of 9 Nov has 499 after five days.
web.startNote: Fewer than half of people who answer a question get to see verses (26 of 58). That is the leak to fix first: the verse should appear before they are asked anything else. Web /start completions are 2 of 88 in 28 days.
web.splitNote: Your ICP is the diaspora (US, UK, CA, AU), but they are fewer than 1 in 5 visitors. In the 7 days to 12 Nov US search CTR was 1.8% against 1.9% for India, and US results rank lower (position 7.5 vs 6.7).
web.topPagesNote: The top page is the Hindi Gita page, which pulls Indian, Hindi-reading visitors (not the ICP). The English blogs at 1.4 to 1.7% CTR (Krishna quotes, best translation) are where better titles pay off for the diaspora.
